query:
SELECT count(*) AS "total!"
           FROM kb_edges e
           JOIN edges_visible_to($1) v ON v.edge_id = e.id
          WHERE (e.source_id = $2 OR e.target_id = $2)
            AND (CASE WHEN e.source_id = $2 THEN e.target_table ELSE e.source_table END)
                  IN ('kb_resources', 'kb_blobs')
